# LinkLang - Professional Polish-English Translation Services

LinkLang provides professional translation and interpreting services across Scotland and the UK.

## Services

- **Document Translation** - Professional Polish to English and vice versa translation for contracts, certificates, medical records, and more. From £35.
- **On-site Interpreting** - Face-to-face interpretation services within 25 miles of Aberdeen. From £70/hour.
- **Phone & Video Interpreting** - Remote interpretation via Zoom, Teams, or WhatsApp. Available UK-wide. From £45 per 30-minute session.
- **Public Services Support** - Assistance with UK public institutions like Universal Credit, HMRC, Jobcentre Plus, and NHS.
- **Business Packages** - Corporate translation and interpreting services with flexible retainer options.

## Key Information

- **Based in:** Aberdeen, Scotland
- **Service Area:** In-person within 25-mile radius; Online across entire UK
- **Languages:** Polish ↔ English
- **Quality:** All work is completed personally - no automated translation or outsourcing
- **Confidentiality:** Documents are secure and never shared with third parties

## Coverage Areas

Aberdeen, Stonehaven, Banchory, Inverurie, Ellon, Peterhead, Fraserburgh, Turriff, Glasgow, Edinburgh, Dundee, Inverness, Perth, Stirling, Aberdeenshire, Highlands, Scottish Borders, Fife, Moray, Angus, and UK-wide online.
